Hi Simon — copying a short technical draft for the runbook and the SOW outline. High level:

- EU onshore option: deploy dedicated tenancy nodes in eu-central-1 with customer-key KMS integration; data-at-rest encryption managed by customer KMS (HSM option available) and encryption in transit via TLS1.3. Expected median p95 latency change ~+12ms in EU for existing EU-based traffic.
- Retention: we support configurable retention windows (30/90/365 days) — migration cost scales with retention length due to snapshot and re-encryption steps.
- APAC pilot: warm-standby model (standby nodes spun with prefix caching + KV sync). Pilot pricing includes a 2-week canary (25% traffic), then ramp to 100% for 2 weeks, then review. We recommend 6-week total.

I've attached a draft SOW (nova_sow_draft_v2.pdf) and a short diagram of failover (redwood_fallback_diag.png).

If you can confirm target RPS and retention choice, Ben/Marissa and I will finalize the estimate and runbook.

Hi Simon / Lara / procurement team,

Appreciate the details — we've finalized a short proposal and a line-item price table. High-level summary:

1) EU Onshore Addendum (monthly): dedicated eu tenancy w/ customer KMS, p95 latency delta estimated +12ms. Monthly run-rate: $28,000.
2) One-time migration (re-encryption + snapshot ops): $18,500. We can apply a migration credit of $7,500 if you sign a 24-month term.
3) APAC Warm-Standby Pilot: pilot package (6-week) priced at $6,000 (fixed) + burst units billed at $0.45 per 1k-token-equivalent during peak. We recommend configuring autoscale thresholds to cap burst costs; Monica's runbook includes sample thresholds.
4) Cross-region failover SLA: 99.8% availability for regional primary; in the event of flavor-eligible cross-region failover, we offer a service credit matrix up to 20% of monthly run-rate based on incident severity.

I've attached: finalized SOW (updated) and the failover diagram for your tech review. I've also prepared a DocuSign SOW link if you are ready — I'll add a 30-day trial credit (applied as $5k one-time credit) to help cover verification testing.

Proposed next steps:
- Please confirm RPS & retention selection (you previously committed to 20 RPS APAC pilot / 365-day audit retention).
- If procurement agrees, I'll send the DocuSign SOW and we can schedule a kickoff for the pilot the week after signature.

If you'd like an internal SLA exception (higher availability) we can route to solutions engineering but that would change monthly run-rate.
